outcome.technical: plugins/audit/hooks/guard-edits.py: `_is_tree_config` and the three-way comparison in `_is_audit_config` are replaced by one function, `_names_audit_config(real, top)`, asked of the tree the path lands in and of a nested candidate tree alike. It answers by file identity where the resolved path and `<top>/.claude/audit.config.json` both exist (`os.path.samestat` over the two `os.stat` results, the same comparison `os.path.samefile` makes, so the stats are not taken twice); where exactly one exists they are different files; where neither exists (a creating write) the components of the path below `top` are compared with `_config.CONFIG_REL`'s - exact spelling -> held; equal only without regard to case -> `_volume_folds(holder)` is asked of the deepest existing directory on the path (an entry of that directory, then the directory and each one above it, looked up under its case-swapped name and compared by `samestat`; names whose swap does not round-trip are skipped; nothing cached). folds -> held; does not fold -> another file, allowed; cannot be asked (no swappable name, or an OSError other than not-found) -> held, and the refusal/ask gains the one new clause `_CASE_BLIND` ('matched to the config's without regard to case'). OSError from the volume question: held, deliberately - it is only reached after the spelling already matched the config without regard to case, which is the position the task's rule 3 assigns to a volume that cannot be asked; every other OSError/ValueError still lands in `_is_audit_config`'s `except` -> not the config (allow), as before and as SECURITY.md's fail-mode row says. A nested candidate exists only when `_config_shaped_top(real)` (strings only) finds the last components equal to CONFIG_REL's without regard to case, and `_config._holds_repository(top)` holds. Callers in `decide` and `_decide_mcp` pass the clause into `_config_verdict`'s tail; `_CONFIG_DENY`/`_CONFIG_ASK`/`_CONFIG_DRIVE_DENY` unchanged. The docstring sentence that a creating case-variant spelling is not matched is gone; the new stated non-match is a hard link to a NESTED tree's config under a name that is not the config's (the identity question for a nested tree is asked only of a shape-matching path). A hard link to the project's config under any name inside the project stays refused.
